description:
Nutrition lives as FuelPanel at the bottom of Start (apps/web/src/screens/start/StartScreen.tsx:148). At 390px only the two meters are visible above the fold, the eight quick-add chips stack one per row below it, and Start ends up showing two different "＋ Log something else" buttons: the freeform workout entry (StartScreen.tsx:11-12) and the custom-food form (FuelPanel.tsx:213, 232). The second one does something else entirely.

SCOPE
- New route /fuel (apps/web/src/router.tsx, beside startRoute at :103) and a sixth tab in TABS (apps/web/src/app/TabBar.tsx:3-9): Start, Program, Fuel, Trends, History, Body. Check the tab bar still fits at 390px with six mono labels.
- The Fuel page's Today view takes over what FuelPanel renders today (meters, quick-adds, logged list, custom add, target edit). Move it, don't duplicate it: FuelPanel's queries and mutations go with it.
- Start keeps a compact card: protein and calorie meters, up to three quick-add chips, "+ Log food", and "Open Fuel ›" (mockup: StartCard). Both surfaces read the same ["fuel","today"] query, so logging on either updates both.
- Rename the freeform entry on Start to "+ Log a workout off-program", so "Log something else" stops meaning two things on one screen.

NOT IN SCOPE
Carbs/fat, the day stepper, grouping and the Week view. Each has its own ticket in this phase.

Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/CD3dbZS6upyEbpCcv25c2g (boards Main, StartCard).
title: Give Fuel its own tab and page, and shrink Start's fuel panel to a summary card
